qualityGate.reason: The TypeScript Playwright tests compile and use the API correctly with proper async/await usage. Test case IDs are preserved in the test titles. Selectors mostly use accessible roles and names, which is good practice. Assertions are applied correctly, including to locators and URL checks. The tests are maintainable and reusability could be improved slightly by defining a helper method to navigate to the category. The product count check in TC-003 is basic but valid.
